label: PAX3::MAML3

sections.text: PAX3 encodes a paired-box transcription factor involved in neural-crest and skeletal-muscle development.
MAML3 encodes a transcriptional coactivator in Notch signaling.
The fusion combines PAX3 DNA binding with MAML3 transcriptional coactivation and drives a mixed neural/myogenic expression program. It is the predominant fusion in biphenotypic sinonasal sarcoma.
This is usually a low-grade but locally aggressive sinonasal sarcoma with a tendency to local recurrence.
